records.title: Tanzania Agri-Inputs Platform
records.description: Ministry-linked public platform providing searchable information on quality seeds, fertilizers, crop-protection products and agricultural input-sector participants.

records.title: Tanzania Agricultural Routine Data System
records.description: Ministry system for collecting, managing and transmitting agricultural performance information from local government authorities through regional structures.

records.title: Tanzania Mobile Kilimo market access service
records.description: Ministry online systems include Mobile Kilimo, designed to help farmers, livestock keepers and fishers access markets for agricultural products through mobile technology.
